name: Decision Index frozen suite
selection: Deterministic hash sample without replacement; ESCI proportional locale × relevance; request-budget datasets retain complete linked groups; no outcome-based selection.

selected-rows.jsonl.gz.format: gzip JSON lines; one request per line with state, questions, expected, metadata/scoring and _evaluation

excluded-questions.json.purpose: Questions dropped from scoring for every engine so no model is graded on a case another model was structurally unable to attempt.

notes: Request caps count planned logical evaluations. Transport retries or context splits are logged separately and may add HTTP attempts.
Cached successful pilot responses reused only for identical full request SHA256; original latency and provenance retained.
Game protocols and budgets are pinned separately.
Interactive benchmarks (MiniWoB++, ScienceWorld, Boxoban, RTFM, Hanabi, Codenames) are not part of this static suite.
Rebuilding from public sources is documented in the decision-index repository (docs/suite.md).
